scope: Stripe S01 structural baseline/count reconciliation; repository read-only

rule_basis.company_count: CLAUDE.md:135 defines source_count as the number of source summary pages in wiki/sources/ mentioning the company, one per source page rather than per raw file.
rule_basis.catalogs: rules/ingest.md:102 calls company and provider indexes exhaustive reverse catalogs; rules/lint.md:101 assigns a PSP's source pages to its PSP index.
rule_basis.operational_set: The count below uses Stripe-owned source pages: source-stripe*.md web pages, the legacy top-level source-github-stripe-postman.md, and wiki/sources/stripe/github/{source,changelog}-*.md. Every member has type: source and a stripe tag. Twelve source pages owned by Braintree or Metronome also carry a stripe tag; literal any-mention counting would need a separately specified cross-provider policy. Historical equality at daf1e9513 supports the Stripe-owned convention used by the existing count.

stripe_index_gap.classification: All eleven are existing Stripe web source pages for PayPal documentation; none of the 643 source-prefixed index links is dead relative to the 654-page Stripe-owned source-prefixed set.

company_sources_section_gap.classification: Existing Stripe-owned source pages absent from the company's ## Sources reverse catalog. The four extra links in that section are valid Metronome cross-provider sources, not dead Stripe links. This catalog gap does not create or remove source pages.

narrow_history_evidence.finding: Company source_count 664 and Stripe-owned source inventory 664; last sampled matching baseline before Terminal iOS.

Added source-github-stripe-terminal-ios.md and changelog-github-stripe-terminal-ios.md, both type: source, and added both to Stripe index and company source links, but left source_count at 664; inventory became 666.
Added analogous Terminal Android source and changelog, and changed source_count 664 to 666; inventory became 668, preserving the two-page deficit.
No additions or deletions in the 668-page Stripe-owned source set; subsequent changes to nested GitHub source/changelog files were modifications only. Current source_count remains 666.

proposal_decision.meaning: The proposed S01 work can accurately state that it updates existing source pages and creates zero new source pages; its own source-page count delta is zero.
proposal_decision.aggregate_repair_scope_separate: Do not describe the current source_count or catalogs as already reconciled. A separately authorized coordinator aggregate repair should evaluate source_count 666 to 668 under the Stripe-owned convention, add the 11 missing PayPal web links to wiki/stripe-index.md, and add the 68 existing Stripe-owned pages to the company ## Sources list. If the literal any-mention definition is adopted, first decide whether the 12 Braintree/Metronome Stripe-tagged pages belong in Stripe's count and catalog; do not silently substitute 668 as that broader count.
